description: Adopt an app built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit, Figma Make or any GitHub repo / zip onto this AppCrane: behind its SSO, scanned, deployed to the SANDBOX only. Two steps. (1) action="analyze" with github_url (public, or private with github_token) or zip_url (an https link to a zip). Nothing from the project is executed: AppCrane reads the files, detects the framework, build/start commands and port, the env vars the code reads, Supabase/Firebase/Clerk/Auth0 usage and hardcoded secrets, and returns an adoption report plus an adoption_id. A Lovable/Bolt/v0/Replit project URL is not importable directly; the error says which export step to use. (2) action="adopt" with adoption_id, name, slug and env_vars=[{key,value}] creates a Crane-hosted managed app, commits the code plus any missing Dockerfile/deployhub.json/health endpoint, stores the env vars encrypted for the sandbox, starts the first sandbox deploy, records the intake (purpose, data_classification, intake_answers) and with open_requests=true opens one request per needed change for the coder. stage must be "sandbox"; production is refused. A report with critical risks (e.g. a Supabase service-role key in client code) needs acknowledge_risks=true. Follow the deploy with appcrane_wait_deploy.

acknowledge_risks.description: adopt: required when the report has critical risks.

action.description: analyze a source, or adopt a previous analysis.

adoption_id.description: adopt: the id returned by analyze.

env_vars.description: adopt: sandbox env vars to set (stored encrypted). Values found in an uploaded .env are used for keys you leave out.

github_token.description: analyze: a token that can read a private repository. Used once, never stored.

intake.description: adopt: intake record for the new app.

open_requests.description: adopt: open a request per change the report asks for.

ref.description: analyze: branch, tag or commit. Defaults to the default branch.

slug.description: adopt: URL slug, lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

stage.description: adopt: must be "sandbox". Production is refused.

zip_url.description: analyze: https URL of a project zip (private addresses and redirects are refused).

name: appcrane_adopt_app
